LanguageData.FeatherMedals_CitationDesc: Write or edit the Tale of Honor about the deeds this trophy represents.
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_CeremonyAttendance_ToolTip: Up to 40% of adorning quality. More colonists means a more meaningful adorning.
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_CeremonyVenue_ToolTip: Up to 40% of adorning quality. Hold the adorning in an impressive room for a better outcome.
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_CeremonyCitation_Written_T: "20% of adorning quality. The Tale of Honor adds weight and meaning to the trophy."
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_CeremonyCitation_None_Tool: "No Tale of honor written. You will be prompted during the adorning, or write one before the adorning for 20% bonus to adorning quality."
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_Ceremony_Started: {LEADER_labelShort} has begun the adorning ritual of a trophy upon {PAWN_labelShort}.
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_WriteCitationDesc: Tell the Tale of Honor, boast the deeds of a warrior. This tale will be untouchable once the trophy is adorned.
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_TakeOfHonorLetterLine1: {PAWN_labelShort} has been ceremonially adorned with a {MEDAL} by {PRESENTER_labelShort}.
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_TakeOfHonorLetterLine2: The {QUALITY} adorning ceremony was attended by {ATTENDEES} tribe members, and the deeds of {PAWN_labelShort} have been recognized by the tribe.

LanguageData.FeatherMedals_TrophyUnlocked: This trophy is unlocked and can be removed from the pawn. Click to lock.
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_MustBeLeaderOrGuide: Must be the Leader, Moral Guide, Lead warrior or Lead sage.
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_FailTrophyNeedsCeremony: Trophies can only be adorned via ceremonies
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_FailTrophyBiocoded: Trophy belongs to {PAWN_labelShort}, {IMPOSTOR_labelShort} can not equip it.
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_TrophyRemovedTrait: {PAWN_labelShort} has overcome the {TRAIT} trait by facing their fears.
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_TrophyAddedTrait: {PAWN_labelShort} has gained the {TRAIT} trait by facing their fears.
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_Settings_TrophiesRequireCe: If enabled, trophies can only be awarded to colonists via an adorning ceremony. If disabled, trophies will be considered awarded by the first person to wear them. Default: ON
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_Settings_LockTrophyUponAwa: If enabled, once a trophy is adorned to a pawn, it will default to being locked to the pawn inventory. This can be toggled individually on the dedicated tab. This setting does not affect biocoding. Default: ON
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_Settings_PromptForCitation: Prompt for Tale of Honor during Ceremony

If enabled, a dialog will appear during adorning ceremonies to allow the user to enter a Tale of Honor for the trophy if one has not already been added to the trophy. If disable a window will not appear, but Tale of Honor can still be added prior to ceremony commencing. Default: ON
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_Settings_TrophyDynamicTrai: If enabled, trophies can have a dynamic effect on traits such as gaining a elder trait, or losing wimp when receiving bravery awards.
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_Settings_ShowTrophyCatalog: If enabled, a menu button will show to open a catalog of all trophies in the game, including those added by mods. The catalog shows stats and effects of each trophy. Default: ON
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_Settings_DrawTrophiesOnPaw: If enabled, trophies will be rendered on pawns. Disabling this will stop trophies being drawn on pawns. Use this to turn their rendering off. Default: ON
